name: Biogen Pharmachem Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1995, Biogen Pharmachem Industries Ltd is in the business of trading 
in shares and securities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
BPIL is engaged in the business of trading in shares and securities in the present and future markets. It trades in commodities, including agro-based and precious metals, and other goods. The company also provides stock broking and consulting services. In addition, it generates trades and sells wind power

pros: Stock is trading at 0.67 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 0.78% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.44 Cr.
Working capital days have increased from 67.5 days to 170 days
